The '''personal shelter capsule''' was manufactured by [[Valerenn Environmentals]]. It was an inflatable, self-contained environmental shelter designed to protect the occupant against unforeseen circumstances. Once inflated, the personal shelter capsule was fully [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygenated]] and temperature controlled.
